subject: AppSec assessment / red team SOW — scope, timeline, signoff
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Diane Park <diane.park@fortresssec.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Scope/timeline for annual AppSec assessment + red team

Hi Diane —

Following our discovery call last week, we want to proceed with an annual application security assessment and a focused red team exercise against our inference control plane. Key asks from our side:

- Full-stack web app penetration test (auth, session management, API endpoints)
- Red team (credentialed) focusing on lateral movement from web app -> control plane services
- Deliverables: executive summary, technical findings with reproducible steps, remediation guidance, and retest window (2 weeks)
- Timing: target windows are July 20–24 for the app test, Aug 3–7 for the red team (we can be flexible)
- We will need an SOW with price and a sample schedule, and a procurement-friendly invoice/PO flow for our finance team

Can you send a draft SOW and estimated quote? I’m copying Dev + Neha for technical constraints and procurement.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole\Director, Security Programs\Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RW-Triage-requests.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)]

From: Diane Park <diane.park@fortresssec.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Fortress Security <procurement@fortresssec.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scope/timeline for annual AppSec assessment + red team

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear outline. Attached is an initial proposal and SOW (v1) and a price sheet. High level:

- AppSec pentest (3 testers, 5 days onsite/remote): $28,500
- Red team (2 operators, 5 days): $45,000
- Retest window (2 days): included for critical issues; additional retest at daily rate
- Total estimated spend: $73,500 (we can split invoices per engagement)

I flagged the credentialed access requirements — please confirm the accounts/environment you’ll provide and if we should expect any air-gapped segments. Also included is an optional SOC2-aligned audit add-on if you need reporting tailored for an audit.

Attachments referenced: Fortress-RedTeam-Quote-0626.pdf, RW-AppSec-SOW-v1.docx

Best,
Diane Park\Head of Services\Fortress Security
[Attachment: Fortress-RedTeam-Quote-0626.pdf (pdf, 128KB)]

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Diane Park <diane.park@fortresssec.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scope/timeline for annual AppSec assessment + red team

Diane — quick technical notes from infra:

- We can provide a staging cluster clone for the app tests. It mirrors production traffic patterns but all creds are synthetic.
- For the red team exercise, we can provision a jump host in our dev VPC and provide temporary service accounts with limited scopes; no live customer data will be accessible.
- Expected blackout windows: weekly backup runs Tue 02:00–03:00 UTC; avoid scheduling during those times.

Marissa — procurement will want the SOW to include insurance limits and standard IP clauses. Neha, please advise if we need any specific attestation for the doc.

-Dev

On Wed, Jun 10, 2026 at 08:48 AM Diane Park <diane.park@fortresssec.com> wrote:
> Marissa —
> 
> Thanks for the clear outline. Attached is an initial proposal and SOW (v1) and a price sheet...

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Diane Park <diane.park@fortresssec.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scope/timeline for annual AppSec assessment + red team

Thanks — I reviewed the SOW v1. A couple of procurement/legal asks to include in the SOW before finance can approve:

1) Clarify IP ownership for exploit write-ups (we want reproduction steps but no claim of IP over our code).
2) Standard liability cap: 1x contract value.
3) Data handling: explicit statement that no customer data will be exfiltrated; list of data types accessed.
4) Wording for background checks if testers will be credentialed and have privileged access.

Also — can you add a short schedule matrix (days -> activities) and a single line for the PO instructions? Finance needs an invoice matching the SOW line items.

If Fortress can accept those edits, I’m happy to move to signoff. Markus, FYI on budget — we have $80k allocated for security engagements in Q3.

Neha\Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance\Redwood Inference

From: Diane Park <diane.park@fortresssec.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Fortress Security <procurement@fortresssec.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@acme-products.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scope/timeline for annual AppSec assessment + red team

Neha/Marissa —

Thanks for the feedback. We can accept those contract edits. Summary of changes we will deliver in SOW v2:

- IP clause: findings and exploit steps are deliverables; no transfer of code or ownership rights over customer IP.
- Liability cap set to 1x contract value.
- Data handling section added with explicit list and non-exfiltration commitment.
- Background-check addendum: we perform basic identity checks on credentialed testers; detailed checks available on request.
- Added a schedule matrix and PO/invoice instructions (net 30).

Attached: RW-AppSec-SOW-v3.docx (tracked changes). Once you confirm, we’ll issue a final invoice and DocuSign link for signature.

Couple of logistics: can you confirm July 20–24 and Aug 3–7 windows work? If yes, we’ll reserve those slots and issue the updated SOW.

Regards,
Diane
[Attachment: RW-AppSec-SOW-v3.docx (docx, 84KB)]
